fragments.text: Hi Alex. It's Martha Clines here. James White gave me your number. I hope you don't mind me calling you.

sentences.speaker: Martha
sentences.translation: 嗨，亚历克斯。我是玛莎·克莱恩斯。詹姆斯·怀特给了我你的号码。希望你不会介意我打电话给你。

fragments.text: Of course not. How are you, Martha?

sentences.speaker: Alex
sentences.translation: 当然不会。最近怎么样，玛莎？

fragments.text: Good thanks. I'm
because I need a bit of advice.

sentences.speaker: Martha
sentences.translation: 近来还不错，谢谢。我给你打电话是因为我需要一些建议。

fragments.text: Oh yeah. What about?

sentences.speaker: Alex
sentences.translation: 没问题。关于什么呢？

. Best thing I ever did. I'm still working there.

sentences.speaker: Martha
sentences.translation: 真的吗？你在做什么？

in

to begin with. I didn't do well in my exams at school and I was really worried because I failed Maths. But it didn't actually matter because I did lots of courses on the job.

sentences.translation: 刚开始的时候，我非常紧张。我在学校的考试中表现不佳。因为我的数学考试不及格，所以我真的很担心。但实际上那并不重要，因为我在工作上做了很多功课。

but I wish I'd done that one instead.

there.

sentences.speaker: Martha
sentences.translation: 我听说了很多关于JPNW培训的好消息。似乎那里会有很多机会。

fragments.text: Yeah, definitely. Because of its size you can work in loads of different areas within the

sentences.translation: 当然是的。由于它的规模（很大），你可以在公司内部不同区域工作。

minimum wage than

sentences.translation: 薪水怎么样？我知道你的最低薪水比正式员工要低。

fragments.text: That's right - which isn't great. But you get the same number of days' holiday as everyone else. And the pay goes up
if they offer you a job at the end of the training period.

sentences.speaker: Alex
sentences.translation: 的确——这一点不是很好。但是，你能获得与其他人一样的假期天数。如果他们在培训期结束时为你提供工作，那么工资就会大幅增加。

fragments.text: Yeah, but I'm not doing it for the money - it's the experience I think will be really useful. Everyone says by the end of the year you gain so much

too. You're given lots of different things to do. I enjoyed it all - I didn't even mind the studying.

sentences.translation: 没错，是这样的。这就是最有用的地方，而且它有多样性。你会有很多不同的任务要做。我很喜欢这些——我也不介意学习（的过程）。

fragments.text: Do you have to spend any time in college?

sentences.speaker: Martha
sentences.translation: 那你必须在学校待一段时间吗？

fragments.text: Yes, one day each month. So you get lots of support from both your tutor and your manager.

sentences.speaker: Alex
sentences.translation: 是的，每个月一天。所以你能得到来自导师和经理双方面的支持。

fragments.text: That's good. And the company is easy to get to, isn't it?

sentences.speaker: Martha
sentences.translation: 很棒。公司（交通）方便吗？

so the location's a

sentences.translation: 是的，它离火车站很近，所以这个位置真的很有优势。

sentences.speaker: Alex
sentences.translation: 确定了，这个月的23日。

there's nothing to worry about. Everyone's very friendly.

sentences.translation: 我不知道应该穿什么。你觉得呢？

fragments.text: OK. Thanks. Any other

sentences.speaker: Alex
sentences.translation: 好的。谢谢你。还有其他建议吗？

fragments.text: Erm, well I know it's really obvious but arrive in plenty of time. They hate people who are late. So

you know exactly where you have to get to. And one other useful piece of advice my manager told me before I had the interview for this job - is to smile. Even if you feel terrified. It makes people respond better to you.

sentences.speaker: Martha
sentences.translation: 嗯，显然你要到早一些。他们讨厌迟到的人。所以一定要知道你具体去哪儿。另一个有用的建议是我的经理在面试前告诉我的——微笑，即使你感到害怕，这会让人们给你更好的回应。
